lifecycleScripts.afterStart: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/demo-plugin bash -lc 'if [ ! -f vendor/autoload.php ] || [ ! -f vendor-prefixed/autoload.php ]; then mkdir -p vendor-prefixed && composer install --prefer-dist --no-interaction --no-progress; fi' && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate demo-plugin
